title: Flat Troll Blue Glass Shelf, 16-Inch Wall Mount Triple Tier With Towel Bar, Solid Brass Hardware, Allied Brass
description: Finished in Flat Troll Blue, wall mount glass shelf, 16 x 5 inches, with integrated towel bar and triple-tier storage for bathroom organization, which presents a distinctive, muted blue-gray tone that adds artistic character to contemporary bathroom designs. Features 3/8-in (0.38 in) thick tempered, beveled-edge glass with solid brass hardware for durable traditional bathroom hardware style. Concealed screw mounting creates a clean look; includes glass shelf and all installation hardware; uses #8 x 1 1/4" screws. Overall size: 16 in length x 5 in width x 18 in height; supports up to 6 lb. Assembly not required. Limited Lifetime Warranty. Ideal as a bathroom wall shelf for classic bath accessories and heritage bathroom fixtures. Allied Brass.
